failure_summary.description: Answered a school mentioned in the clue instead of the explicitly requested man, despite the existing answer-slot guidance.
For bare name pairs or lists, defaulted to a relationship or umbrella region instead of the specific context-supported answer.
Stripped “Lake” from the canonical proper name “Lake Superior” under the guidance to omit supplied category words.

patch.reasoning: Clarify how to handle bare pairs and lists without assuming their obvious relationship or broad grouping is the requested answer. Also distinguish removable category words from head nouns that are integral to a canonical proper name. The man-versus-school error is already covered by the answer-slot guidance, so it does not warrant a duplicate rule.

edits.target: - Treat terse statements, quoted fragments, and incomplete phrases as information-seeking clues when appropriate. Infer the answer slot from the wording, then use the context to identify the entity or value that satisfies the clue.
edits.content: - For a bare pair or comma-separated list of named entities, do not default to their obvious relationship or to an umbrella group. Use the context and framing to identify the specific fact sought, such as a shared place or affiliation, or a particular entity; return that named value rather than a related relationship or broader category. If no unique intended answer is supported, do not invent one.

edits.target: - Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer, and include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.
edits.content: - Do not strip a head noun that is part of an entity's canonical proper name. Omit a supplied category word only when the remaining words are themselves a complete conventional name.
